AI Notes.value: Veteran pixel artist, illustrator and author (b. 1956), living on Orcas Island, Washington. Industry legend in color cycling: illustrated all original backgrounds for LucasArts Loom and some of The Secret of Monkey Island, later Ron Gilbert's Thimbleweed Park; his color-cycling technique (animation via palette manipulation on a still image) is iconic and now lives in his Living Worlds app (iOS/Android). Also a published novelist (The Book of Joby, Tor 2007) and runs an illustrated serial, TWICE. Very senior, ~40 yr career; fully autonomous master of his craft (5). Work Status left Unknown: he reportedly does background/concept art for a Seattle game company (employed) while also self-publishing art and fiction, and no current source resolves this at the bar. No public email; socials are Twitter/Facebook (@Mawkyman), no Instagram found. Discovery path was Ben Leonard on Twitter (not a Jonathan relationship). Sources: his site (about/contact), CGMagazine interview, Macmillan/Goodreads, Encyclopedia.com.
